$comment: Regression budgets checked in CI. API and page numbers are p95/worst-of-3 against a production build on a GitHub runner with a seeded user (60 chats, one 200-message chat), set at about 3-5x the measured runner baseline to absorb noise. Bundle numbers are gzipped First Load JS per build target. Raise a budget only when the growth is intended, in the same PR.

bundle.$comment: Gzipped First Load JS per page, page plus its layouts. vercel = `npm run build:vercel` (webpack), docker = `npm run build` (Turbopack).
